title: Delicious Jamaican Koi Casserole
description: A Caribbean-inspired casserole that combines the flavors of Jamaica with the freshness of koi fish. Perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Season the koi fish with Jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the koi fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a separate skillet, heat a little olive oil over medium heat. Add the pak choi stems and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the chopped leaves to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until wilted.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked koi fish, pak choi mixture, and casserole.
Drizzle zesty lime juice over the top and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the fish is flaky.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
